standard.summary: 对结构化 JSON caption 中的 NL
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: On the NL in a structured JSON caption
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 对结构化 JSON caption 中的 NL（自然语言描述）部分整块丢弃的概率，与 tag dropout 独立。0 = 不丢弃

advanced_en.principle: Probability of dropping the NL (natural-language description) part of structured JSON captions wholesale, independent of tag dropout. 0 = never drop.
